not_measured: tickets: the app's own in-app tickets table, every ticket as it stands now (not only those opened in the window). Statuses folded: open = Open, Needs Triage, Reopened; in_progress = In Progress, Blocked, Waiting on Customer, Waiting on Eng, Waiting on Vendor, Mitigated, Monitoring; done = Resolved, Closed, Won't Fix (the app's own closed set)
input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd: chat turns only (chat_turn_usage); workflow (subagent) tokens are not in them, workflow money is workflow_cost_usd
cost_usd: not stored by the app; estimated from the turns' tokens at the app's own price table (lib/inference-pricing.ts), the same way its usage page does
workflow_runs: automation_runs rows of type workflow (subagent runs) started in the window; schedules, system crons, connector syncs and browser runs are not counted
people_active (alpha): 1 chat turn(s) recorded no signed-in person and are not attributed to anyone

workflow_cost_usd (alpha): 1 of 3 workflow run(s) used the model but recorded no cost; the figure is the recorded cost only; they used 41,000 input and 900 output tokens (the run table records no model, so they are not priced here)
by_agent lodr-filings cost_usd (alpha): 1 of 1 run(s) used the model and none recorded a cost
by_user (alpha): 1 person(s) have no display name in the app's people records and are shown as Member N, numbered by when they joined the workspace
by_user workflow_runs (alpha): 1 workflow run(s) could not be traced to a signed-in person (no session owner recorded, or started by a service) and are in no one's count
by_user workflow_runs (beta): null, because the session owners table that ties a run to the person who started it could not be read (42P01 relation "agent_session_owners" does not exist)
by_agent: turns is the main agent's measure (chat turns) and runs a specialist's (workflow runs); the other is null, not applicable. Specialist names are the app's workflow names
by_user: people who sent a chat turn or started a workflow run in the window, named from the app's people roster; email addresses are never shown
